description: This file contains shell functions related to firmware upgrade operations for Fortinet devices. It includes functions for byte swapping, building partition maps, updating firmware info, and performing device upgrades, specifically tailored for Fortinet hardware management via scripting.

methods.name: fortinet_bswap32
methods.description: Swaps byte order of a 32-bit integer and outputs in hex format.

methods.name: fortinet_by2bl
methods.description: Converts a size in bytes to the number of blocks (0x200 bytes per block), rounding up.

methods.name: fortinet_build_partmap
methods.description: Builds a partition map from new and old partition size/offset strings.

methods.name: fortinet_update_fwinfo
methods.description: Updates firmware information (name, kernel, root filesystem) in the device's firmware-info partition.

methods.name: fortinet_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process by extracting firmware components and writing them to device partitions.
